response.sql: WITH orders_per_account AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_orders FROM orders_per_account), above_avg_accounts AS (SELECT opa.account_id, opa.order_count FROM orders_per_account opa, overall_avg oa WHERE opa.order_count > oa.avg_orders), above_avg_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_above_avg FROM above_avg_accounts) SELECT aaa.account_id, aaa.order_count, aaa.order_count - oa.avg_orders as above_overall_avg, aaa.order_count - aaa_avg.avg_above_avg as above_above_avg_average FROM above_avg_accounts aaa, overall_avg oa, above_avg_average aaa_avg ORDER BY above_above_avg_average DESC LIMIT 10
